description: Source code implementing various attention mechanisms for Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in PyTorch, including general, vectorized, and full attention modes with support for masks and scaling.

classes.name: CachedGraph
classes.description: Cache structure for MPS graph related tensors used in attention computations.

methods.name: ensure_4d
methods.description: Expands 3D tensors to 4D and reshapes tensors with more than 4 dimensions for attention operations.

methods.name: sdpa_general_mps
methods.description: Performs general scaled dot product attention using MPS graph, supporting masks, scaling, and causal masking.

methods.name: sdpa_vector_fast_mps
methods.description: Performs fast vectorized attention in a single pass using MPS compute shaders.

methods.name: sdpa_vector_2pass_mps
methods.description: Performs vectorized attention in two passes for improved numerical stability or performance.

methods.name: sdpa_full_attention_mps
methods.description: Performs full attention mode with masking and scaling using MPS.

methods.name: _scaled_dot_product_attention_math_mps
methods.description: Main entry point for scaled dot product attention, dispatching to optimized or general implementations based on input characteristics.
